name: Michael McCaul
stance: Treats advanced AI chips as national security assets and supports restricting their sale to China.

statements.text: I applaud President Trump’s decision to restrict the sale of NVIDIA's incredibly advanced AI semiconductor chips to the CCP. If we are to win the great power competition with China, we must protect these critical national security assets.
I see no reason, first of all, that we should be selling AI military-grade technology chips to China.

I am deeply concerned about the administration’s decision and urge them to treat these chips not just as an opportunity for a business deal, but as a sensitive national security asset that must be kept out of our adversaries’ hands.
you cannot sell military-grade AI technology to China.
